name: Clementi & West Coast
summary: University-west practicality, park connectors, and better family value than core central — with East-West Line access and school-run trade-offs toward Bukit Timah/Dover.
body: Clementi and West Coast attract households trading Orchard prestige for space and rent relief while staying west of town near NUS, Science Park, and park connectors. Hawker centres, malls, and MRT coverage make daily life straightforward once you accept longer trips into the civic centre. International-school runs may still mean driving toward Bukit Timah, Dover, or one-north depending on campus. Humidity + older condo aircon stacks mean budgeting for quarterly servicing — a practical living-mode neighbourhood after the first-month chaos settles. Compare against Bukit Timah if school adjacency matters more than rent.
housingMix: Condos, HDB (eligible), some landed toward West Coast.
commuteNotes: East-West Line (Clementi); Circle Line connections via Buona Vista; buses along West Coast Highway.
